description: This file extends account journal and account move line models in Odoo to add date validation logic for accounting entries, including a new boolean field 'allow_date' and methods to check move dates against accounting periods.

classes.name: account_journal
classes.description: Extends the account.journal model to include a boolean field 'allow_date' indicating if dates outside the period are allowed.

classes.name: account_move_line
classes.description: Extends the account.move.line model to include date validation logic in check_date method, ensuring move dates are within the specified period unless 'allow_date' is set.

methods.name: check_date
methods.description: Validates that the date of an account move is within the period unless 'allow_date' is enabled.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the write method to include date validation before updating records.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Overrides the create method to include date validation before creating new records.
